CustomField.inlineHelpText: A field reachable from the Quote Line, such as SBQQ__Product__r.Family or SBQQ__Group__r.SBQQ__BillingFrequency__c. Set this OR Dimension, not both. Paths are validated against the schema when definitions load, so a typo fails generation with a clear message rather than an opaque query error. Note that a field on the Quote or its Account has one value per quote, so it produces a single group - useful as a label, not as a breakdown.
CustomField.label: Field Path
